confirmed_facts.fact: Laptop (SKU LT-14) delivered 4 Oct 2026; return requested 3 Nov 2026, 29.8 days after delivery, outside the 7-day electronics window under Return v2.
Serial recorded at inspection matches the dispatch serial LT14-90551, supported by the dispatch scan and the warehouse photo.
Warehouse inspection found the laptop does not power on, with no physical or liquid damage, and a bench test with a known-good charger failed.
Return parcel was picked up sealed at 2.24 kg and received at 2.23 kg; courier events are in order.
The defect route is available because the fault appeared within 12 months of delivery.

findings.description: Return was requested outside the 7-day electronics return window, so a standard return is not available; the defect and warranty route applies instead.

evidence.quote: I know it is past the return window but it is only a month old.

findings.description: Warehouse inspection confirms a fault with no sign of misuse or liquid damage, which meets the defect confirmation requirement.

evidence.quote: Does not power on. No physical or liquid damage. Bench test with known-good charger failed.
Fault looks like a board failure

policy_references.quote: A manufacturing defect that appears within **12 months** of delivery is covered even after the return window has closed.
The defect must be confirmed by warehouse inspection or a technician report.
The seller arranges the repair or replacement.

findings.rationale: The return is outside the 7-day electronics window, so a standard refund does not apply. The warehouse inspection confirms a fault with no misuse or liquid damage, and the serial matches the dispatch record, so the Defect policy route applies. The remedy is repair or replacement arranged by the seller, tracked as a warranty case; a refund is offered only if neither is available within 14 days. A person should approve.
findings.uncertainty_note: All records agree. The 0.03 kg weight difference between pickup and receipt is within normal range and is a signal only. Whether the seller can supply a repair or replacement within 14 days is not yet known.
